Hi Jiang.

You need to take the log2 of the residuals. CEL files store only
positive numbers.

This question has been answered many times. For starters, have a look
at:
http://www.mail-archive.com/aroma-af...@googlegroups.com/msg01015.html

Cheers,
Mark
